verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs state directly that sandboxes run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, without exposing production systems. That is a documented microVM-level boundary. The documentation is only a short marketing-level statement, and nothing independently confirms it. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the isolation architecture (hypervisor/technology, network and egress isolation, tenant separation guarantees), independent or hands-on corroboration of the boundary

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems

citations.quote: Run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs.
Run AI agent output, user uploads, or third-party scripts without exposing your production systems.
